Bash(node -e "import\('playwright-core'\).then\(async m => { const b = await m.chromium.launch\({channel:'chrome', headless:true}\); const p = await b.newPage\({viewport:{width:1440, height:810}}\); await p.goto\('http://localhost:3055/', {waitUntil:'networkidle'}\); await p.waitForTimeout\(1500\); const s = await p.evaluate\(\(\) => { const section = document.querySelector\('section[aria-label=\\"AegisOne hero\\"]'\); return section ? { tag: section.tagName, class: section.className, height: section.offsetHeight } : null; }\); console.log\(JSON.stringify\(s\)\); const info = await p.evaluate\(\(\) => { const s = document.querySelector\('section[aria-label=\\"AegisOne hero\\"]'\); const total = s.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight; return { hero_top: s.offsetTop, hero_height: s.offsetHeight, scrollable: total, vh: window.innerHeight }; }\); await p.evaluate\(\(y\) => window.scrollTo\(0, y\), info.hero_top + info.scrollable * 0.25\); await p.waitForTimeout\(600\); const transform = await p.evaluate\(\(\) => { const divs = document.querySelectorAll\('div'\); let result = null; divs.forEach\(d => { const s = window.getComputedStyle\(d\); if \(s.transform && s.transform !== 'none' && s.transform.includes\('matrix'\)\) { result = { transform: s.transform.substring\(0, 50\), className: d.className.substring\(0, 50\) }; } }\); return result; }\); console.log\('Transform found:', JSON.stringify\(transform\)\); await b.close\(\); }\)")

Bash(node -e "import\('playwright-core'\).then\(async m => { const b = await m.chromium.launch\({channel:'chrome', headless:true}\); const p = await b.newPage\({viewport:{width:1440, height:810}}\); await p.goto\('http://localhost:3055/', {waitUntil:'networkidle'}\); const info = await p.evaluate\(\(\) => { const s = document.querySelector\('section[aria-label=\\"AegisOne hero\\"]'\); return { hero_top: s.offsetTop, hero_height: s.offsetHeight, scrollable: s.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight }; }\); await p.evaluate\(\(y\) => window.scrollTo\(0, y\), info.hero_top + info.scrollable * 0.3\); await p.waitForTimeout\(600\); const z = await p.evaluate\(\(\) => { const st = document.querySelector\('.sticky'\); if \(!st\) return 'no sticky'; const parent = st.parentElement; const allDivs = parent.querySelectorAll\('div'\); let found = null; allDivs.forEach\(d => { const cs = window.getComputedStyle\(d\); if \(cs.transform && cs.transform !== 'none' && cs.willChange === 'transform'\) { found = cs.transform.substring\(0, 60\); } }\); return found; }\); console.log\('Transform:', z\); await b.close\(\); }\)")
